Abacus.AI grew from 83 to 278 employees between 2022 and 2026, raising $90M along the way, most recently a Series C in October 2021.

## About

Abacus.AI provides a platform for creating and managing AI agents that handle tasks ranging from document creation to complex decision-making. Its customers use these agents to automate white-collar work and build software systems, with thousands of AI-native businesses launched on its platform.

The company has scaled to 278 employees since its 2019 founding, with backing from investors including Coatue and Decibel Partners. Its $90M funding includes a Series C round in 2021, though recent headcount growth data is unavailable.
